native_lowering.interpretation: The predicted reduction materialized. The candidate's 32 ordered comparisons include key and position comparisons; ordered comparisons should decrease, not disappear. Baseline pair counts represent two visits to a shared body, not two static copies. These instruction inventories do not measure cycles, latency or distributed critical-path work.
memory_and_support: The joint body has one VMEM load at record 1232074 and two output stores at 1232155 and 1232201. It has no internal branch, loop, DMA or intermediate memory spill.
Five vnez.u8 instructions and additional selects expose predicate round trips through vector registers. The implementation is not free of predicate-conversion overhead.

Each baseline sort body has nine VMEM loads, nine stores, a dma.simple at record 1234009 and a vwait.ge at 1234012. These are computational-body support costs, distinct from shared code-loader activity.
Candidate outputs are s32[1,128] with minor-to-major [1,0], tile [1,128] and memory space 1. Consumer results retain the baseline s32[128] tiled layout.

All 80 native index-normalization bodies are instruction-identical across versions. Representative baseline ranges [4774,4778) and [5012,5016) match candidate ranges [4761,4765) and [4973,4977). Thus these output bitcasts introduce no additional normalization instructions.
No whole-model memory-traffic or spill reduction is inferred from this scoped inspection. Gather, count, GEMM, weighting and synchronization costs remain relevant.

optimization_mechanism_detail.algorithm: Compute inverse[i] = sum_j ((key[j] < key[i]) OR ((key[j] == key[i]) AND (j < i))). Then compute order[d] = sum_i where(inverse[i] == d, i, 0).
optimization_mechanism_detail.correctness: Signed comparisons and original-position tie breaks define a strict total order, including duplicate keys and invalid-route sentinels. Ranks uniquely cover 0..127, so reconstruction has one contributor per destination. Both reductions are exact and bounded by 127. There is no subtraction overflow, key packing or floating-point approximation.
optimization_mechanism_detail.dispatch: The existing specialization requires non-EP routing, int32 IDs and keys, exactly 128 flattened routes, and x64 disabled. Other configurations retain the existing fallback paths.
